problem: Loot::AllowedForPlayer takes Player, ItemID, CurrencyID, type, needs_quest, optional LootItem*. HandleMasterLootItem and three Group calls omitted CurrencyID. The compiler converted type into CurrencyID, needs_quest into type, and the nonnull item pointer into true for needs_quest; the actual LootItem pointer defaulted to null.

For ordinary nonquest items the shifted true flag falsely requires HasQuestForItem. For quest items the shifted type becomes currency and currency0 is rejected. For a conditional nonquest item needed by an active quest, HasQuestForItem can pass while DB conditions are skipped because the real item pointer is null.

The prior cached-slot fix does not cover these paths: master distribution stores directly through StoreNewItem, while GroupLoot and DoRollForAllMembers build participant lists independently of LootItemInSlot.
